title: Recover connections without losing the conversation
description: Inject a deploy, broker interruption, or network flap. Tune reconnect admission and choose whether clients resume from live traffic, a snapshot, or a durable event cursor.

incidents.label: Gateway rolling deployment
incidents.detail: One quarter of sockets close while the rest of the region remains healthy.

incidents.label: Fan-out broker interruption
incidents.detail: Connections stay open, then gateways reconnect subscriptions after retained events accumulated.

incidents.label: Regional network flap
incidents.detail: Most clients lose connectivity together and repeatedly retry while the path recovers.
